anika-cs: FYI Vireo Systems flagged rising unit cost and sporadic tail latency in eu-north during their morning traffic spike. Renewal touchpoint in ~2.5 weeks. My proposed play: conservative int8 on high-throughput stateless endpoints, swap short-chat paths to a smaller local model, and route high-priority traffic to a tiny reserved EU pool during peak. Thoughts?

jorge-se: Agree on proactive move. Main ask: can we validate on their real prompt corpus first? Also watch for tokenizer quirks with emojis and non-latin scripts; we saw those bite us previously.

mei-ml: I can run an eval today. Plan: per-layer int8 calibration, keep fp16 for system and long-response flows (>400 tokens), and a fallback rule for hallucination signals. Will produce quality deltas (BLEU/ROUGE-like + manual spot checks). ETA: 12h.

tobias-ops: Canary routing sketch (5% -> 25%):
```json
{"policy": "route_by_priority", "routes": [ {"path": "/api/chat", "max_tokens": 64, "model": "vireo-orca-mini", "weight": 0.05, "pool": "eu-reserved"}, {"path": "/api/chat", "model": "redwood-13b-qint8", "weight": 0.9, "pool": "shared-eu" } ] }
```
Start during their 07:30-09:30 CET window. I'll add token-level tracing and cost breakdowns.

ci-bot: Canary scheduled: vireo.canary -> eu-reserved at 3234567960 (5% for 1h). Monitors: p95_latency, p99_latency, gen_quality_delta, cost_per_1k_tokens. Alerts: #customer-success.

anika-cs: I'll request ~200 anonymized prompts and permission for the canary. Scheduling an enablement call Tue 08:00 CET to align on metrics to watch.

jorge-se: Rollback criteria proposal: auto-revert if p95 latency increases >10% or gen_quality_delta >1.0% absolute, or hallucination rate signal >0.7%. Capture cost savings per 1k tokens for the renewal brief.

mei-ml: Will deliver dashboard comparing baseline vs int8 vs orca-mini with quantitative deltas and 25 manual spot checks. Also include a short latency distribution plot for prefix caching effects.

tobias-ops: Owners noted: @mei-ml (eval), @jorge-se (deploy+rollback), @tobias-ops (routing/canary). @anika-cs will coordinate customer comms and capture feedback in renewal playbook.

anika-cs: Great. I'll follow up when prompts arrive and post the enablement invite. Thanks team :thumbsup:
